contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ DN GRATIA NVS PF AVG

A copper alloy Nummus of Gratian (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads: GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse: Emperor dragging captive to right. Mint Arles AD 375-378. LRBC p.56 no.540. Obverse Legend reads: DN GRATIA NVS PF AVG. Obverse: Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis: 6 o'clock
